001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.hilt;
002
003import com.google.gson.Gson;
004import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
005import dagger.Module;
006import dagger.Provides;
007import dagger.hilt.InstallIn;
008import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent;
009import javax.inject.Singleton;
010
011/**
012 * Hilt module for providing a Gson instance as a dependency. This module configures bindings in
013 * the Hilt dependency injection framework to supply a singleton instance of {@link Gson}.
014 */
015@Module
016@InstallIn(SingletonComponent.class)
017public class GsonModule {
018
019  /**
020   * Provides a singleton instance of {@link Gson}, configured using a {@link GsonBuilder} to exclude
021   * fields with certain modifiers.
022   *
023   * @return a singleton instance of {@link Gson}.
024   */
025  @Provides
026  @Singleton
027  Gson provideGson() {
028    return new GsonBuilder()
029        .excludeFieldsWithModifiers()
030        .create();
031    // 2/17/25 Create a GsonBuilder, and invoke methods to configure it and build an instance
032    //  of Gson.
033  }
034}
